items.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Sol 与 Luna 模型家族
items.title_en: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 Sol and Luna Model Family
items.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Sol and Luna, a new flagship model family, prompting extensive Hacker News discussion about pricing, coding-agent usage limits, and model quality comparisons.

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5
items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5，API 价格下调
items.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5 with cheaper API pricing
items.summary: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5, a new flagship model with improved communication and lower API pricing, sparking intense Hacker News discussion about frontier AI pacing and market impact.

items.title: Pentagon says overreliance on AI contributed to missile strike on Iran school
items.title_zh: 五角大楼：过度依赖AI导致伊朗学校遭导弹袭击
items.title_en: Pentagon: AI Overreliance Contributed to Deadly Strike on Iranian School
items.summary: The Pentagon reportedly found that overreliance on AI contributed to a missile strike on an Iranian school, raising urgent questions about accountability and the use of AI in military targeting.

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and a new price war
items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5，OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Sol 与 Luna 掀起价格战
items.title_en: Anthropic and OpenAI launch Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and Luna amid price war
items.summary: Simon Willison shares first impressions of Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and an emerging price war among frontier AI models.

items.title: vllm-project/vllm released v0.30.0
items.title_zh: vLLM v0.30.0 发布：762 次提交，新增 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 支持与 GPU 权重缓存守护进程
items.title_en: vLLM v0.30.0 ships 762 commits, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and a GPU weight-cache daemon
items.summary: vLLM v0.30.0 ships 762 commits adding new model support (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash), a persistent GPU weight-cache daemon for fast engine restarts, and a DeepSeek-V4 CPU backend.

items.title: 'We hacked the FBI:' Hackers say they have data on all FBI employees
items.title_zh: 黑客声称窃取了全部FBI员工数据
items.title_en: Hackers claim they stole data on all FBI employees
items.summary: Hackers claim to have stolen data on all FBI employees, sparking widespread discussion about cybersecurity and data protection failures.

items.title: There's a high chance of devices being sold with GrapheneOS preinstalled in 2027
items.title_zh: GrapheneOS 有望在 2027 年实现设备预装
items.title_en: GrapheneOS May Ship Preinstalled on Devices by 2027
items.summary: GrapheneOS may be preinstalled on Motorola devices by 2027, offering a privacy-focused alternative to mainstream Android.

items.title: 25 位菲尔兹奖得主警告 AI 或与数学研究目标错位  陶哲轩、邓煜等 25 位菲尔兹奖得主发表联合声明，警告 AI 快速用于解决数学问题可能导致 AI 发展目
items.title_zh: 25位菲尔兹奖得主警告AI或与数学研究目标错位
items.title_en: 25 Fields Medalists Warn AI May Be Misaligned With Math Research Goals
items.summary: 25 Fields medalists warn that using AI primarily for solving math problems may misalign AI development with the core goals of mathematical research.

items.title: 🤖 DeepSeek 发布 DSec 沙箱平台技术报告：每日服务 300 万个沙箱，支撑智能体训练
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 与清华发布 DSec 沙箱平台技术报告
items.title_en: DeepSeek and Tsinghua release DSec sandbox platform technical report
items.summary: DeepSeek and Tsinghua released a technical report on DSec, a production sandbox platform serving about 3 million sandbox instances daily to support large-scale AI agent training and evaluation.

items.title: 🤖 DeepSeek 本周将向联合国安理会通报 AI 风险  两名知情人士称，中国 AI 初创公司 DeepSeek 将在本周向联合国安理会通报人工智能带来的风
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 本周将向联合国安理会通报 AI 风险
items.title_en: DeepSeek to Brief UN Security Council on AI Risks This Week
items.summary: DeepSeek will reportedly brief the UN Security Council on AI risks this week, alongside OpenAI's Sam Altman and Anthropic representatives, in a high-level meeting on AI and international security.
